Our task is to find A, B, and C such that

−x2+7x+1(x2+9)(x−2)=Ax+Bx2+9+Cx−2.

Multiplying both sides by (x2+9)(x−2) gives

−x2+7x+1=(Ax+B)(x−2)+C(x2+9).

For x=2, we get −(2)2+7(2)+1=C(4+9)11=13CC=1113.

For x=0, we get −(0)2+7(0)+1=(A(0)+B)(0−2)+1113((0)2+9)1=−2B+9913−2B=−8613B=4313.

For x=1, we get −(1)2+7(1)+1=(A(1)+4313)(1−2)+1113((1)2+9)7=−A−4313+11013−A=2413A=−2413.

Hence, −x2+7x+1(x2+9)(x−2)=(−2413x+4313)x2+9+(1113)x−2=−24x+4313(x2+9)+1113(x−2)
